description: This Java class implements an in-memory device connection service as part of the Eclipse Hono project. It manages associations between tenant IDs, device IDs, and their last known gateways, providing methods to set and retrieve these mappings. It uses Spring annotations for dependency injection and is designed as a Vert.x verticle, integrating with the Hono device registry.

classes.name: MapBasedDeviceConnectionService
classes.description: A Spring-managed, Vert.x verticle service that maintains last known gateway associations for devices in memory. It provides methods for updating and retrieving these associations, enforcing maximum device limits per tenant.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Sets the last known gateway for a specified device under a tenant, respecting the maximum device limit per tenant.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last known gateway information for a specified device under a tenant.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Injects the configuration properties for device connections.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the current device connection configuration.

methods.name: createLastKnownGatewayJson
methods.description: Creates a new JSON object representing the last known gateway with the provided gateway ID and current timestamp.

methods.name: setLastUpdateDate
methods.description: Adds or updates the last update timestamp in the JSON object.
